note: Measured exceptions to tools/motion-lint.mjs (UI-LOCKDOWN part D). A row covers the findings of one rule at one place: { rule, file, where (the selector, '@keyframes <name>', 'animate()', 'requestAnimationFrame(<name>)' or the media path), property? (one property; absent covers them all), reason, measured (the run and the number: dropped frames, layer size, LoAF) }. A row without a measurement, or one that no longer matches a finding, fails the receipt.

rows.reason: The mark's track links (owner 2026-10-24, the living mark): an inline SVG that repaints whole every frame anyway, since its wheels, hull, turret, crew and antenna move by transforms inside the SVG, which browsers paint rather than composite; the dash offset adds no area. Reduced motion stops it (the static frame).
rows.measured: Painted box: the boot card's mark is clamp(170px, 20vw, 270px) wide (270 px at 1440, 164 px under 768 px, height min(34vh, 150px) on short phones); a public page's mark is 24 to 46 px tall. One SVG, no layer of its own, no layout.

rows.reason: The mark's idle loop period (brandMarkMotion.ts LOOP_S), not a UI transition: one loop moves the links four pitches and the wheels two spoke steps, so it closes on itself. Reduced motion stops the loop.
rows.measured: LOOP_S 1.2 s; TRAVEL 240 degrees of a 5.4-unit wheel = 22.62 units, PITCH = TRAVEL / 4 = 5.655 units, the keyframes' dash offset.
